dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: Climb the hill, climb the hill... Well, there's no sanatorium to be found even if you do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the sanatorium on the mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: It was torn down long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: Ghost stories or not, there's no treasure up there. You should go home now.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: I lived there for seven years. The air was so cold that it could freeze even time and wind. Seven years passed like seven days, gone in the blink of an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: But we all have to go down the mountain. Even one pushed by the wind still moves forward.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: There's nothing left to see. Nothing left to find. If you go up there and end up disappointed staring at ruins, don't blame this old man for not warning you.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: Thank you. It's damp near the mountain. Take care of yourself.
